from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyTaxData(BaseModel):
    """Income tax expense data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    income_tax_expense: float | None = Field(description="Income tax expense amount from the financial report")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_tax_data: list[CompanyTaxData]
